statement: The intrinsic compensated Palm-sine law gives a precise candidate arithmetic characteristic function, beyond the matched low moments.
hypotheses: Identical global derivative tilt, negative Fourier observable, one root and declared band; arithmetic assertions assume RH.
already_proved: Intrinsic full RMT law and the arithmetic means, covariance and full third tensor in their ranges.
conjectural: Existence and identification of the full arithmetic band law.
next_step: Prove a fixed-band characteristic-function comparison or new higher-support arithmetic estimates.
counterexamples: Finite moment agreement and kernel analogy cannot identify a law; per-matrix root normalization gives a different model.
tests: Independent kernel limits, regularized determinant and finite exact trace checks.
significance: Replaces a vague RMT analogy with an explicit law and a precise missing arithmetic input.
difficulty: Exact next-step estimate stated in the director note; publication priority remains unassessed.

statement: The exact low-support moment polynomial supplies its own obstruction to unchanged all-order extrapolation.
hypotheses: Arithmetic coefficients only when rb<1/2; the all-order obstruction is an unconditional formal statement.
already_proved: Explicit quartic factor, real MGF zero, signed inverse and finite negative Gram witness beyond the true window.
conjectural: Actual higher moments and the first new arithmetic frequency chambers.
next_step: Compute a genuine main term outside the old length window and compare the first required corrective term to rooted CUE.
counterexamples: All admissible Hankel tests remain positive; a formal witness outside the range is no source contradiction.
tests: Two independent source extractions and three exact/interval Gram methods.
significance: Eliminates a specific tempting route from a finite moment formula to a full law.
difficulty: Exact next-step estimate stated in the director note; publication priority remains unassessed.

statement: A separate analytic-sampling bound with exact local mass repairs the small-scale limitation of an aggregate logarithmic remainder.
hypotheses: RH, shrinking subpower band, fixed reciprocal clock and classical continuous fourth moment.
already_proved: The minimum of h²+L^−M and L²h² yields h^(3/2) at every subset scale and a Brownian process.
conjectural: A uniform Ch² bound across the full range and useful numerical path onsets.
next_step: Track constants or extend the two-bound method to other weighted zero processes.
counterexamples: An interval-independent o(1) error alone cannot imply tightness; random shrinking pulses supply a countermodel.
tests: Independent disk factor, overlap, strip interpolation, Stieltjes signs and dyadic chaining.
significance: A reusable method for turning qualitative aggregate estimates into a genuine process theorem.
difficulty: Exact next-step estimate stated in the director note; publication priority remains unassessed.

statement: The signed third tensor detects cross-band cosine/sine dependence invisible to their exact zero covariance.
hypotheses: Common positive exponent range below 1/6; nonnegative weights have positive integrals, not merely pointwise nonzero values.
already_proved: A negative mixed cubic survives weak limits by uniform fourth moments, including disjoint supports.
conjectural: The joint full arithmetic law and sine-marginal distribution.
next_step: Test the full candidate DPP mixed characteristic function against new arithmetic estimates.
counterexamples: Uncorrelated components need not be independent; null-set test weights do not give strict negativity.
tests: Two signed HLZ derivations and two chamberwise projection trace calculations.
significance: Gives a precise failure of independent polynomial-band phase models.
difficulty: Exact next-step estimate stated in the director note; publication priority remains unassessed.
